test_title: PYST 213: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 2nd Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

36, 74, 55
solution:
• The logic followed here is:
 
• 36, 74, 55 → (36 + 74) ÷ 2 = 110 ÷ 2 = 55

Similarly,

 
• 40, 52, 46 → (40 + 52) ÷ 2 = 92 ÷ 2 = 46

Hence, '**40, 52, 46**' is the correct answer.
